summary: MoonLake Immunotherapeutics filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Master Commercial Supply Agreement and a Capacity Agreement with Vetter Pharma International GmbH for manufacturing of prefilled application systems for its product candidate sonelokimab. This is a routine supply contract, not a special situation. No financial terms such as price per share, stake, premium, or deal value are disclosed. The agreement includes standard termination provisions for cause, change of control, and insolvency. As a supply agreement for a drug candidate, this filing does not qualify as any special-situations category.
